items.title: Sanitize path-like/code-like tokens out of the claimsShrinkage scan text before the trigger-word regex runs
items.context: In evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts ~line 1420-1440), build narrowingText as today, then strip backticked spans (`...`), tokens containing '/' (path segments), and hyphenated or dotted file-name-shaped tokens (e.g. partial-done-recovery.ts, not-covered.md) before testing the claimsShrinkage regex. Plain prose trigger words must keep matching.
items.userSees: A DONE summary whose changes text names core/partial-done-recovery.ts no longer produces the unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap, while a prose claim like 'the remaining cases were deferred' still blocks DONE without a confirmed shrinkage decision.

happy.desc: done_intent_equivalence_check on a lightweight-path story whose summary.changes names core/partial-done-recovery.ts reports no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap.

edge.desc: Trigger words inside backticked spans or slash-segmented paths (e.g. `deferred`, src/excluded/list.ts) do not trigger; the same words as plain prose still trigger.

adversarial.desc: A summary that names partial-done-recovery.ts AND separately claims 'remaining scope deferred' in prose still produces the unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap - the sanitizer must not swallow surrounding prose or become a bypass for genuine shrinkage claims.

verificationEvidence.note: fileNameDone plus the full strip-rule battery (16 strip/keep cases) green at final head 16c97d4009

Re-bound at post-review head: codeTokenDone (backticked `deferred`, src/excluded/list.ts) plus F-006/F-007/F-009 controls (backtickProseDone, slashProseDone, slashEnumerationDone, slashEnumerationDotDone, urlControlDone) all green.

Re-bound at post-review head: proseShrinkDone asserts genuine prose claim next to a path token still fires; 7 verified review findings (F-001..F-003, F-005..F-009) each closed with RED-first bypass coverage.

items.title: Decide and document whether the bare trigger word 'remaining' is too broad
items.context: An earlier B-d6a0 summary draft tripped the heuristic on 'remaining' while describing pre-existing unrelated suite failures. Evaluate keeping, narrowing (e.g. only match shrinkage-flavored phrases like 'remaining work/items/scope'), or dropping it; record the decision and rationale in the story plan/summary, and if the vocabulary changes, cover the change with a smoke assertion.
items.userSees: The story artifacts contain an explicit keep/narrow/drop decision for 'remaining' with rationale; if narrowed, a smoke case shows the narrowed behavior.

happy.desc: Decision recorded; heuristic behavior matches the recorded decision.

edge.desc: If narrowed: 'the remaining suite failures are pre-existing' no longer triggers while 'remaining scope deferred' still does.

adversarial.desc: If kept: rationale explains why the false-positive rate is acceptable rather than silently ignoring the question.

verificationEvidence.note: Re-bound at post-review head: NARROW decision implemented as remaining[\s./_-]+<scope-noun> (connector widened by F-003/F-008); behavior matches plan.md decision section.

Re-bound at post-review head: preexistingDone (pre-existing suite failures, no gap) and remainingScopeDone / hyphenRemainingDone / underscoreRemainingDone / dotRemainingDone (scope-noun forms, gap fires) all green.
Re-bound at post-review head: plan.md CHK-003 decision section documents narrow-vs-keep-vs-drop rationale plus the F-003/F-008 connector revisions; risk notes list every residual with direction.
